qti-correct-response.qti-value: The sun and the wind do not deliver energy at the same moments: solar panels produce nothing at night and little in winter, while wind turbines stand still when there is no wind. Because sunny and windy periods often fall at different times, a mix of both gives a steadier supply. Relying on one source makes a country vulnerable to bad weather, breakdowns and price changes, so a mix is more reliable.
